title: Stop honoring client position/orientation on avatar create
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Stop honoring client position/orientation on avatar create
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L2095-2097: "Optional: `displayName` (String), `visualRef` (String), `visualType` (String), `worldState` (Object). The server sets `id`, `userId` (to the caller's userId), `position` (to the region's `spawnPosition`), `orientation` (to the region's `spawnOrientation`), ..." (the 'position ... if explicitly supplied' create-error row was removed).
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:32-37; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:380-386
Now: SERVER_SET_ON_CREATE omits position and orientation, citing the removed 'teleport-on-entry' row. A client-supplied position or orientation on create is kept.
Change: Add position and orientation to SERVER_SET_ON_CREATE (invalidProperties), or always overwrite them with the spawn values.
Verifier correction: Add position and orientation to SERVER_SET_ON_CREATE (invalidProperties, the RFC 8620 handling for server-set properties). Update the avatar_set.rs:326 test, whose oracle is the removed teleport-on-entry row.
